 "study": "Huang, 2019",
 "design": "parallel 2-arm",
 "country": "",
 "duration": "18 months",
 "n_randomized_total": "92",
 "experimental_arm": {
  "label": "low-carbohydrate diet (LCD)",
  "intervention_description": "daily carbohydrate intake was limited to less than 90 g without any restriction to the total energy",
  "n_randomized": "41",
  "n_analyzed": "41",
  "hba1c_change_mean": "-1.44",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion": "0.59",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion_type": "SD",
  "hba1c_baseline_mean": "9.95",
  "hba1c_baseline_sd": "1.04",
  "hba1c_final_mean": "6.84",
  "hba1c_final_sd": "0.59"
 },
 "control_arm": {
  "label": "traditional diabetic diet (TDD)",
  "intervention_description": "target total calorie intake was calculated by multiplying the ideal weight by 25 kcal/kg for those with a BMI between 18.5 and 24, 20 kcal/kg for overweight/obese subjects (BMI > 24) and 30 kcal/d for underweight subjects with a BMI < 18.5",
  "n_randomized": "42",
  "n_analyzed": "42",
  "hba1c_change_mean": "-1.01",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion": "1.06",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion_type": "SD",
  "hba1c_baseline_mean": "8.70",
  "hba1c_baseline_sd": "1.01",
  "hba1c_final_mean": "7.69",
  "hba1c_final_sd": "1.06"
 }
}
